name: skill-reviewer
description: Review any Agent Skill repo and get a tiered quality profile — not pass/fail, but "which star-tier profile does this match, and what's missing to reach the next one". Two layers: a deterministic lint for packaging and security thresholds, then LLM craft review for trigger design, writing quality, and scope. Derived from a 97-repo star-gradient study whose core finding is that star count tracks packaging, not craft.
